title: Cabin Over-Pressure Depressurization
description: If cabin pressure exceeds 900 hPa and aircraft altitude is below 10,000 ft and secondary sensor confirms reading above 900 hPa, the controller shall actuate the outflow valve to 100% and output state 1.

title: Nominal Cabin Valve Closure
description: If cabin over-pressure conditions are not satisfied, the controller shall command outflow valve to 0% and return state 0.
